project_info.theme: Messi-style character invites users to TV360 to claim rewards
project_info.color_palette: White, black, Viettel red, soft beige, Argentina sky blue, product gray

main_subject.detail: A cartoon-styled Lionel Messi-like character in an Argentina striped kit sits casually on a bench in front of a large blank television. A speech bubble says 'VÔ NGAY TV360 NHẬN QUÀ LIỀN'. The headline above reads 'ANH MƯỜI NGỒI ĐÂY TỪ CHIỀU QUÀ CÒN NHIỀU'. Large prizes stand beside him: a white PlayStation 5-like console on the left and a dark Samsung smartphone on the right.
main_subject.style: Soft digital cartoon illustration with big-headed celebrity caricature and clean prize-promo layout

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square illustrated social poster for a TV360 prize-promo invite featuring a Messi-like character. Centerpiece is a polished digital cartoon of a Lionel Messi-style football star in an Argentina striped kit sitting casually on a bench in front of a large blank TV. Include the exact visible text 'ANH MƯỜI NGỒI ĐÂY TỪ CHIỀU QUÀ CÒN NHIỀU' and 'VÔ NGAY TV360 NHẬN QUÀ LIỀN'. Background is a simple bright outdoor or stadium-side bench setting with a large TV. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo at top, a white PS5-style console in the left foreground, and a dark Samsung smartphone in the right foreground. Technical style: polished digital cartoon illustration, soft illustrated ambient lighting, gentle gradient wash and clean line shading, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
